title: MSR reporting window
body: Synthetic policy note: next MSR attestation for participating importers is due mid-September. Commercial stock cannot be counted toward MSR stock.

title: Mekong late-season rainfall
body: Synthetic weather note: delayed rains in the Mekong Delta raise a modest risk of tighter fragrant 5% availability in 45–60 days. Not a disruption. Treat as elevated, not high.

title: Intra-ASEAN bulk freight eased
body: Synthetic logistics note: Ho Chi Minh–Singapore and Bangkok–Singapore parcels have eased about 2% over the last fortnight.

title: India export-policy watch
body: Synthetic policy note: no new restriction this week. Pakistan 1121 Steam Basmati 2% stays on the book as its own product, not a substitute for Vietnam fragrant.
